title: Directed Forest Validator
prompt:
Implement `is_valid_forest(edges) -> bool`. `edges` is an iterable of directed `(parent, child)` pairs whose node IDs are hashable. It describes a directed forest when every child has at most one parent, the graph has no directed cycle, and no exact edge appears twice. Multiple independent trees and multiple roots are allowed.

Return `True` for an empty edge collection. Return `False` for a self-loop, a duplicate exact edge, any node with indegree greater than one, or a cycle of any length. An iterative indegree-elimination pass is one suitable way to detect a cycle after enforcing the parent rule. Do not mutate the input.

example.reasoning: The graph has two roots and no shared child or cycle, so it is a forest rather than one required connected tree.
